name: gina-lib-connector-error
description: Transient-vs-permanent classification for datastore connector errors (#CE1). Normalizes socket errno, driver codes/names, ANSI SQLSTATE, MongoDB error labels and Couchbase N1QL cause codes into err.isTransient + err.transientReason so a controller can render an honest retryable response without string-matching vendor error text. Pure, total (never throws), zero runtime deps, CJS.
